strategy: Replace the unfiltered first-1000 issue enumeration inside the WP-08 GitHub adapter with a repository-bound, state-bound, title-scoped GitHub issue search dedicated to ReleaseRun ledgers. Reject incomplete, malformed, or over-1000 scoped results; retain body contract parsing and all existing actor, run identity, attempt budget, candidate SHA, terminal conclusion, update, close, dispatch, and production-closure boundaries.

changes.responsibility: discover WP-08 ReleaseRun ledger candidates through a bounded exact-scope issue search and fail closed when the result set cannot be proven complete
changes.reason: the generic first-1000 issue enumeration cannot see historical active ledger #696

changes.responsibility: prove scoped discovery finds an old ledger independently of unrelated issue volume and rejects incomplete or excessive search results
changes.reason: existing fakes always place the ledger in the first returned row and cannot reproduce the production pagination defect

unchanged_boundaries: scripts/wp08_release_state.py remains the only ReleaseRun state contract owner
scripts/wp08_release_coordinator.py and scripts/wp08_release_recovery.py remain the only transition decision owners
only an authorized repository owner or the recorded authorized actor can issue control comments

retirement still requires exact current run ID, exhausted attempt budget, eligible control state, completed protected-main workflow_dispatch identity, matching candidate SHA, and a failure-like conclusion
authorization still requires protected main and no discoverable active ReleaseRun
semantic failure is never blindly retried and production_closed remains false
no existing issue state is edited manually and no workflow is dispatched by this repair
forbidden_repairs: Do not hand-edit or directly close issue #696.
Do not bypass the ReleaseRun body contract or trust title text as state.
Do not treat incomplete GitHub search results as absence of an active ledger.
Do not remove multiple-active-run detection or authorize a second controller.
Do not weaken actor, run ID, candidate SHA, protected-main, attempt-budget, terminal-conclusion, or production-closure checks.
Do not modify workflow files, product services, task-ledger completion, environment configuration, secrets, or production evidence.
required_invariants: ReleaseRun discovery is repository-bound, issue-only, state-bound, and scoped to the exact WP-08 Release title marker before body parsing
search incompleteness, invalid payload shape, or more than 1000 scoped ReleaseRun candidates fails closed
only bodies accepted by parse_issue_state can become ReleaseRun authority
zero, one, and multiple active ledgers remain distinguishable and multiple active ledgers are rejected
issue-comment retirement and new authorization consume the same single discovery authority
the repair itself cannot update an issue, dispatch a workflow, close WP-08, or set production_closed

focused: a title-scoped search finds an old valid ReleaseRun ledger that generic repository pagination would miss
the existing exhausted failed-run retirement path still closes its exact issue and never dispatches WP-08
counterexamples: incomplete GitHub search results fail closed
more than 1000 scoped ReleaseRun candidates fail closed
non-Release titles and invalid bodies never become authority
regression: WP-08 retirement, recovery, coordinator, reconciler, and full skill-control-plane tests remain green
negative_path: the repair does not use the generic repository issue enumeration endpoint
the repair does not alter workflow dispatch, issue transition, authorization, retry, or production closure semantics

risks: GitHub issue search has a 1000-result ceiling; the adapter must reject rather than truncate if the scoped ReleaseRun set ever reaches that ceiling.
Title search is an acquisition filter only; the machine body contract must remain the semantic authority.
GitHub can report incomplete search indexing; such a response must block all ReleaseRun decisions until a complete query succeeds.
rollback_plan: Revert the adapter and focused tests; ReleaseRun state remains untouched, #696 remains open, and no new WP-08 authorization is allowed until another exact discovery repair is approved.
